style: warm storybook gouache illustration, soft painterly brushwork, gentle golden light, cozy and nostalgic, rich but soft colours, Indonesian countryside river valley with pine forests and rice-green hills, no text, no letters, no watermark
grandpa: an elderly Indonesian fisherman with short grey hair, a kind wrinkled face and grey mustache, wearing a faded blue shirt and a woven bamboo caping hat
child: a small child in a yellow raincoat, seen from behind

slides.art: an old bus stopping on a misty mountain road at dawn above a green river valley, a lone young traveller with a backpack stepping off
slides.en: The bus left me at the edge of the valley, just as the mist was lifting off the river.
slides.id: Bus menurunkanku di tepi lembah, tepat saat kabut mulai terangkat dari sungai.

slides.art: a small wooden riverside cabin with a mossy roof and a little dock, a rowboat tied to it, morning light, pines around
slides.en: Grandpa Theo's cabin was exactly as I remembered. The rowboat was still tied to the old dock.
slides.id: Pondok Kakek Theo masih persis seperti yang kuingat. Perahu dayungnya masih tertambat di dermaga tua.

slides.art: close-up of a handwritten letter and a worn leather fishing journal on a wooden table beside a window, warm lamp light
slides.en: On the table, a letter. "If you are reading this, the river is yours now. Take good care of it."
slides.id: Di atas meja, sepucuk surat. "Kalau kamu membaca ini, sungai ini sekarang milikmu. Jagalah baik-baik."

slides.art: an open leather fishing journal with painted sketches of five mysterious legendary fish, half-finished pages, pressed flowers
slides.en: "My journal holds five legends of Riverlight. I never finished their pages. Finish them for me."
slides.id: "Jurnalku menyimpan lima ikan legenda Riverlight. Halaman mereka belum pernah selesai. Selesaikan untukku."

slides.art: a young person standing on the wooden dock at sunrise looking out over a calm shining river, rowboat waiting, birds
slides.en: "Start small. Catch your first fish. The river will teach you the rest."
slides.id: "Mulailah dari yang kecil. Tangkap ikan pertamamu. Sungai akan mengajarkan sisanya."

slides.art: GRANDPA sitting on a mossy rock by a sparkling waterfall pool at noon, patiently tying a hook for CHILD beside him
slides.en: You were six. You wanted the golden carp so badly that you cried when it would not bite.
slides.id: Kamu baru enam tahun. Kamu ingin sekali ikan mas emas itu sampai menangis saat ia tak mau makan umpan.

slides.art: two hands, an old one and a small one, tying a fishing knot together, shimmering water and golden light behind
slides.en: I told you: patience is the real bait. We tied the hook together, knot by knot.
slides.id: Kukatakan padamu: kesabaran adalah umpan yang sebenarnya. Kita mengikat kail bersama, simpul demi simpul.

slides.art: a large glowing golden carp rising in a clear waterfall pool under noon sun, sun rays through the water
slides.en: And when the sun stood high, she rose for us. You never forgot that light. Neither did I.
slides.id: Dan saat matahari tepat di atas, ia muncul untuk kita. Kamu tak pernah melupakan cahaya itu. Aku juga tidak.

cutscenes.titleEN: Memory II — Lanterns on the Lake

slides.art: a lake at night covered with floating paper lanterns, weeping willows on the shore, a young couple in a rowboat
slides.en: Willow Lake, the night of the lantern festival. That is where I met your grandmother, Rose.
slides.id: Danau Willow, malam festival lentera. Di sanalah aku bertemu nenekmu, Rose.

slides.art: a young Indonesian woman in a simple floral dress smiling and releasing a paper lantern onto dark water from a rowboat
slides.en: She laughed at my crooked lantern. I said a koi would carry it to the moon. It sank instead.
slides.id: Ia menertawakan lenteraku yang miring. Kubilang seekor koi akan membawanya ke bulan. Lentera itu malah tenggelam.

slides.art: a glowing koi fish with lantern-like light beneath dark water among lily pads, reflections of lanterns
slides.en: But a koi rose, glowing like a lantern. Rose said it was a blessing. We were married that spring.
slides.id: Tapi seekor koi muncul, bercahaya seperti lentera. Rose bilang itu berkah. Musim semi itu kami menikah.

slides.art: a young strong Indonesian fisherman in a rowboat in a dramatic rocky gorge with rapids and tall pines, struggling with a bent rod
slides.en: When I was young and proud, I fought the ironscale sturgeon of Pinefall Gorge for a whole afternoon.
slides.id: Saat aku masih muda dan sombong, aku melawan sturgeon sisik besi di Ngarai Pinefall sepanjang sore.

slides.art: a snapped wooden fishing rod floating in fast green water among boulders, mist from a waterfall
slides.en: I pulled too hard. The rod snapped, and the line with it. I was furious with the river.
slides.id: Aku menarik terlalu keras. Joranku patah, dan senarnya juga. Aku marah sekali pada sungai.

slides.art: GRANDPA years later teaching CHILD to let the line out gently on a calm evening river, soft light
slides.en: It took me years to learn: strength is knowing when to give line. Pull with the river, never against it.
slides.id: Butuh bertahun-tahun untuk belajar: kekuatan adalah tahu kapan harus mengulur. Tarik bersama sungai, jangan melawannya.

slides.art: a small rowboat in a stormy estuary at night with big waves, rain, and a distant lighthouse beam cutting through the dark
slides.en: One night at Saltreed, a storm caught me far from shore. I could not see my own hands.
slides.id: Suatu malam di Saltreed, badai menangkapku jauh dari pantai. Aku bahkan tak bisa melihat tanganku sendiri.

slides.art: an old lighthouse on rocks with a warm beam, an old keeper with a lantern on the balcony in the rain
slides.en: Then the lighthouse turned toward me. My old friend Ben kept it burning all night, just for me.
slides.id: Lalu cahaya mercusuar berputar ke arahku. Sahabatku Ben menjaganya tetap menyala sepanjang malam, hanya untukku.

slides.art: a huge old grouper fish resting among rocks near a lighthouse in calm morning water, seagulls
slides.en: At dawn, the old king grouper surfaced beside my boat, as if to say: go home. Always find your way home.
slides.id: Saat fajar, raja kerapu tua muncul di samping perahuku, seolah berkata: pulanglah. Selalu temukan jalan pulang.

slides.art: GRANDPA and CHILD sitting together at the end of a wooden dock at night under a huge full moon, feet over the water
slides.en: Our last summer together. We sat on the dock and waited for the moon eel until you fell asleep on my arm.
slides.id: Musim panas terakhir kita. Kita duduk di dermaga menunggu belut bulan sampai kamu tertidur di lenganku.

slides.art: a long glowing blue eel swimming under a moonlit river surface, trailing soft blue light, fireflies above
slides.en: She came, trailing blue light under the water. I did not wake you. I wanted you to find her yourself, one day.
slides.id: Ia datang, membawa cahaya biru di bawah air. Aku tak membangunkanmu. Aku ingin kamu menemukannya sendiri, suatu hari nanti.

slides.art: an old weathered hand writing in a leather journal by lamplight, the moon visible through the cabin window
slides.en: That night I wrote the last line in the journal: one day the river will need you. And you will be ready.
slides.id: Malam itu kutulis baris terakhir di jurnal: suatu hari sungai akan membutuhkanmu. Dan kamu akan siap.

slides.art: a completed leather fishing journal lying open with five beautifully painted legendary fish, a golden ribbon, morning light
slides.en: Five legends, five pages. Grandpa's journal was finally complete.
slides.id: Lima legenda, lima halaman. Jurnal Kakek akhirnya lengkap.

slides.art: a young fisher placing an old bamboo caping hat on their head on the dock at sunrise, back view, river glowing
slides.en: I found his old hat on the hook by the door. It fit better than I expected.
slides.id: Kutemukan topi lamanya tergantung di dekat pintu. Ternyata pas sekali di kepalaku.

slides.art: villagers waving from a small market stall by a riverside dock, children with fishing rods, warm afternoon
slides.en: The village calls me the new keeper of the river now. I like the sound of it.
slides.id: Orang-orang desa kini memanggilku penjaga sungai yang baru. Aku suka mendengarnya.

slides.art: a rowboat drifting on a golden river at sunset toward a distant waterfall, a faint smiling figure of an old man in the clouds
slides.en: Sometimes, when the water is still, I feel him beside me in the boat. Patient. Smiling.
slides.id: Kadang, saat air sedang tenang, aku merasakan ia duduk di sampingku di perahu. Sabar. Tersenyum.

slides.art: a panoramic view of the whole river valley at dusk with a lake, a gorge with a waterfall, an estuary with a lighthouse, lights in the cabin windows
slides.en: The river is mine now. And there are always more fish to find.
slides.id: Sungai ini milikku sekarang. Dan selalu ada ikan lain yang menunggu untuk ditemukan.
